_what: Ku-ring-gai DCP Part 20 (Development near rail corridors and busy roads): which land the chapter applies to, and the map layer that places each named road and the rail corridor. Read by frontend-nextjs/lib/rail-busy-road.ts. The names below are the DCP's own words; the labels are what the NSW maps call the same road.

applies_to.quote: All development that is in, or immediately adjacent to, the rail corridor or a busy road is to be designed in accordance with the SEPP (Transport and Infrastructure) 2021.

adjoining.quote: On lots adjoining the rail corridor and/or a busy road, landscaping is to be designed to:

rail_note.quote: Note: Under the SEPP (Transport and Infrastructure) 2021, Chapter 2, the rail corridor refers to the North Shore rail line.

busy_roads.measured: 2026-10-21: 82 of 87 points sampled every 150 m along the NSW road centreline PACIFIC MOTORWAY (the M1) lie in road-corridor parcels labelled SYDNEY NEWCASTLE FWY (the M1's former name); 4 in unlabelled corridors, 1 in PACIFIC HWY.

busy_roads.limit: Runs in a tunnel; no surface road corridor to adjoin. Lots at its Wahroonga portal adjoin the M1 or Pacific Highway corridors, which are checked.
Only a section of Boundary Street, within the Local Centre boundary. No map layer here places that section, so these lots are not flagged.
Only sections of Horace Street, Link Road and Killeaton Street within the Local Centre boundary. No map layer here places those sections, so these lots are not flagged.

rail_corridor.measured: 2026-10-21: all 62 points sampled every 250 m along the surface rail centrelines (NSW_Transport_Theme layer 7) inside Ku-ring-gai lie in Ku-ring-gai LEP 2015 SP2 Railway Infrastructure land. The cadastre's own railway-corridor parcels do not cover the line: much of it is held as ordinary lots.

tolerance_basis: 2026-10-21, lot (nsw_cadastre_lots) to corridor, metres: 1311 Pacific Hwy Turramurra 0.00 to PACIFIC HWY; 1250 Pacific Hwy Pymble 1.34 to PACIFIC HWY and 0.00 to the cadastre railway corridor; 1428 Pacific Hwy Turramurra 1.21; 1047 Pacific Hwy Pymble 0.00; 33 Killara Ave Killara 0.00 to the LEP rail zone. A lot across a street from the line: 43 Werona Ave Killara, 11.75 m from the railway corridor (not flagged). Not yet measured: a lot one street back from the highway.
